'''Marin''' (Japanese: '''マリン''' ''Marin'') is a minor recurring character in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''.

Marin first appeared in ''[[JN031|The Cuteness Quotient!]]'', in which she competed in the [[Friendship Festival]] with her {{p|Seaking}}. At the awards ceremony, Marin appeared on stage with a trophy, although it remained unknown if she won the competition.

Marin reappeared in ''[[JN063|On Land, In the Sea, and to the Future!]]'', where she was among the competitors taking part in the [[Marine Athletic Race|Kids Marine Athletic Race]]. She ended up finishing eighth.
